models.name: e0_dense
models.description: Dense transformer baseline: 6 full-attention blocks, no loop.
models.title: Dense transformer baseline

models.name: e1_hybrid
models.description: Hybrid mixers, no loop: same 6-block depth as E0, but only one full-attention layer (last). Mixer order follows the FusionDance layout unrolled once: SWA, GDN, GDN, SWA, GDN, full attn.
models.title: Linear-time mixers

models.name: e2_looped
models.description: The initial FusionDance arch in full precision: prelude [SWA] -> core [GDN, GDN, SWA] x r -> coda [full attn]. Train r ~ U{1..7} (mean 4), backprop through the last 4 loops; eval at r=4.
models.title: Looped core block

models.name: e3_ternary
models.description: Ternary weights on the E1 stack: identical layout and training recipe to E1, but every projection inside the blocks is BitNet b1.58 BitLinear (absmean ternary weights, per-token 8-bit absmax activations, straight-through estimator). Embeddings, norms, GDN gate projections (a, b) and short convolutions stay full precision. One ingredient changed vs E1: weight precision.

registry.title: Ternary weights on the E1 stack

models.title: Ternary weights on the E1 stack

models.name: e9_unlooped
models.description: Unlooped control for E2: the same blocks in the same order ([SWA] [GDN, GDN, SWA] [attn]) trained once, without weight sharing, loops or the re-injection layer. Separates the effect of looping from depth and parameter count.
models.title: Unlooped control for E2

models.name: e10_llama_ref
models.description: Reference control: Hugging Face's unmodified LlamaForCausalLM (transformers 5.24.0) at E0's shapes (hidden 384, 6 layers, 6 heads of 64, SwiGLU 1024, tied embeddings, RoPE theta 10000, RMSNorm eps 1e-6, HF's own init). Same data, loop, optimizer, schedule, eval and checkpointing as E0. 13,767,552 params total / 10,621,824 non-embedding, identical to E0. Implementation differences vs E0: HF init (std 0.02 everywhere, no residual-output scaling), half-split RoPE, eps 1e-6, fp32 RMSNorm.
notes: arch hf_llama: Hugging Face's unmodified LlamaForCausalLM, not FusionDance. Drawn as its equivalent stack of full-attention + SwiGLU blocks (HF's init, RoPE layout and norm eps differ, but shapes and param counts match).
vocab_size is not in the config; assumed 8192 (same tokenizer as E0).

registry.title: Reference control: Hugging Face Llama at E0's size

models.title: Reference control: Hugging Face Llama at E0's size

models.name: e11_negeig
models.description: E1 with negative-eigenvalue Gated DeltaNet: identical layout and recipe to E1, but every GDN layer uses beta = 2*sigmoid(b(x)) in (0, 2) instead of sigmoid in (0, 1) (fla allow_neg_eigval). One change vs E1. Motivated by SQ6 arm (e): 100% parity in one pass, length-generalising (ledger C43). Run at E1's tuned LR from K7, same seeds as E1's replication.
